For each NILAS line, its corresponding backcross parent, and the donor parents, flowering time was decomposed into its temperature and photoperiod responses, corresponding to flowering time per se and photoperiod sensitivity, respectively, using a reaction norm approach as described in Drouault et al. (2024).

For each NILAS line, the stage at which the plant was sensitive to photoperiod, expressed as the thermal time from emergence to tassel initiation (Tt em–TI), was assumed to be the same as that of its corresponding backcross parent. The Tt em–TI values, previously calculated in Drouault et al. (2024), were 288 GDD for LH123Ht and 283 GDD for 2369. It was assumed that the introgression of a single haplotype or QTL into the temperate genetic background would not significantly delay Tt em–TI.

Due to a gap in the environmental photoperiod gradient between 12.3 and 14.1 hours (Fig. photoperiod_MET_nilaS), the reaction norm parameters were estimated using the long-day versus short-day (LD–SD) approach described in Drouault et al. (2024). Long-day (LD) and short-day (SD) environments were distinguished using the mean genotype-specific photoperiod threshold of the seven donor parents, which was 13.5 hours. A linear model was then fitted to estimate the reaction norm parameters, following Drouault et al. (2024).

```{r Fit the model for the haplotypes}

# diff_gdd = haplotype effect anthesis measured in gdd
# new_mean_daylength = daylength average in SD and LD with intercept SD on 0

haplotype_TT_flowering$Parameters <- as.factor(haplotype_TT_flowering$Parameters)
haplotype_TT_flowering$Parameters <- factor(haplotype_TT_flowering$Parameters, levels=rev(levels(haplotype_TT_flowering$Parameters)))
haplotype_TT_flowering$DL <- as.numeric(as.factor(haplotype_TT_flowering$Parameters))
haplotype_TT_flowering$DL_num <- haplotype_TT_flowering$new_mean_daylength
#note, I did not allow free values for DL after noting the mean DLs were the same to the tenths 
haplotype_TT_flowering$DL_num[which(haplotype_TT_flowering$DL_num>0)] <- 3.5

## fixed effect model 
fits <- lmList(diff_gdd ~ DL_num | entryid2, data=haplotype_TT_flowering, pool=TRUE, na.action=na.exclude)
int <- as.data.frame(summary(fits)$coefficients[,,1])
int <- cbind.data.frame(haplotype=rownames(int), int)

rownames(int) <- 1:nrow(int)
head(int)
slp <- as.data.frame(summary(fits)$coefficients[,,2])
slp <- cbind.data.frame(haplotype=rownames(slp), slp)
rownames(slp) <- 1:nrow(slp)
head(slp)

#write.csv(int, paste0(saving_path, "haplotype_int", "_",date_today, ".csv"), row.names = F) 
#write.csv(slp, paste0(saving_path, "haplotype_slope", "_",date_today, ".csv"), row.names = F) 

```

```{r summary of haplotype passing threshold}

### Haplotype detected with statistical threshold 
int$BH <- p.adjust(int$`Pr(>|t|)`, method="BH")
count(int[which(int$BH<0.05),])
count(int[which(int$BH<0.05 & int$Estimate <0),])

slp$BH <- p.adjust(slp$`Pr(>|t|)`, method="BH")
slp[which(slp$BH<0.05),]

### Haplotype detected with biological threshold 
slp$biological_threshold <- (1.96*slp$`Std. Error`)
sup_biol <- slp$haplotype[which(slp$Estimate > (slp$biological_threshold))]
inf_biol <- slp$haplotype[which(slp$Estimate < -(slp$biological_threshold))]
biological_detected_haplotype_slope <- c(sup_biol, inf_biol)

int$biological_threshold <- (1.96*int$`Std. Error`)
sup_biol_int <- int$haplotype[which(int$Estimate > (int$biological_threshold))]
inf_biol_int <- int$haplotype[which(int$Estimate < -(int$biological_threshold))]
biological_detected_haplotype_int <- c(sup_biol_int, inf_biol_int)

```

```{r summary effect max-min of the halotype}

haplotype_effect_on_int <- int %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(rp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g[0-9]|i.*", "", haplotype)),
                dp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g|[0-9]i.*", "", haplotype)), 
                qtl = as.numeric(gsub(".*q|g.*", "", haplotype))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(rp) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(min_int = min(Estimate, na.rm = T ), 
                   max_int = max(Estimate, na.rm = T ))

haplotype_effect_on_slope <- slp %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(rp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g[0-9]|i.*", "", haplotype)),
                dp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g|[0-9]i.*", "", haplotype)), 
                qtl = as.numeric(gsub(".*q|g.*", "", haplotype))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(rp) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(min_slope = min(Estimate, na.rm = T ), 
                   max_slope = max(Estimate, na.rm = T ))


```

```{r plot histogram}

slope <- slp %>%
  mutate(
    biological_effect = Estimate > biological_threshold |
      Estimate < -biological_threshold,
    significant_stat = ifelse(BH < 0.05, "yes", "no")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate)) +
  ggpattern::geom_histogram_pattern(
    aes(
      fill = biological_effect,
      pattern = significant_stat), 
      position = "stack", 
    binwidth = 0.5,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.8,
    pattern_fill = "#56B4E9",
    # pattern_colour = "#56B4E9",
    pattern_density = 0.5,
    pattern_spacing = 0.03,
    pattern_angle = 45
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "FALSE" = "#868686FF",
      "TRUE" = "#EFC000FF"
    )
  ) +
  ggpattern::scale_pattern_manual(
    values = c(
      "yes" = "stripe",
      "no" = "none"
    )
  ) +
    theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.background = element_blank(),
        ,legend.position = "none"
        ,legend.direction="vertical"
        ,legend.key.size = unit(5, "cm")
        ,legend.key.height = unit(2, 'cm') 
        ,legend.key.width = unit(1, 'cm') 
        ,legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold")
        ,aspect.ratio = 1
        ,legend.title = element_text(colour="black", size=16, face="bold")
        ,panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
        ,panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour="grey", size = 0.5, linetype=3)
        ,panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour="grey", size = 0.5, linetype=3)
        ,panel.border = element_rect(colour="grey", size = 0.5, fill=NA)
        ,panel.background = element_blank()
        ,plot.title = element_text(face="bold")
        ,axis.title.x = element_text(size=30, margin = margin(t=16), face="bold")
        ,axis.text.x = element_text(size=30, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t=11))
```

```{r summary content of NILAS lines with haplotypes detected}


#### Check if the lines that were marked as significantly different have several intro or candidate gene
### Slope
## Statistics
## Lines with a single ZmPR target region introgressed
slp[which(slp$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype[which(slp[which(slp$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype %in% groupA_NILs$lines)]

## From those lines which does not contain candidate gene in the haplotype region
no_candidates_gene_lines <- summary_qtl_insertion %>%
  dplyr::filter(number_of_candidate == 0)
slp[which(slp$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype[which((slp[which(slp$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype %in% groupA_NILs$lines))] %in% no_candidates_gene_lines$entryid

## Biological
(biological_detected_haplotype_slope %in% groupA_NILs$lines) %in% no_candidates_gene_lines$entryid


### Intercept
## statistics
## Lines with a single ZmPR target region introgressed
int[which(int$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype[which(int[which(int$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype %in% groupA_NILs$lines)]
int[which(int$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype[which((int[which(int$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype %in% groupA_NILs$lines))] %in% no_candidates_gene_lines$entryid

## Biological
(biological_detected_haplotype_int %in% groupA_NILs$lines) %in% no_candidates_gene_lines$entryid

### Table results 
list_to_keep <- c(biological_detected_haplotype_int, int[which(int$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype, slp[which(slp$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype, biological_detected_haplotype_slope)

result_table <- summary_qtl_insertion %>% 
  dplyr::filter(entryid %in% list_to_keep) %>%
  dplyr::select(entryid,
                Nb_ZmPR1:Nb_ZmPR4,
                zmpr1_cct:zmpr4_cacta,
                number_of_candidate) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    number_of_ZmPR_introgressed =  Nb_ZmPR1 +  Nb_ZmPR2 +  Nb_ZmPR3 + Nb_ZmPR4,
    potential_new_coding_region = ifelse((
      number_of_ZmPR_introgressed == 1 |
        number_of_ZmPR_introgressed == 0
    ) & number_of_candidate == 0 ,
    "yes",
    "no"
    ),
    detection_method = ifelse(
      entryid %in% slp[which(slp$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype |
        entryid %in% int[which(int$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype,
      "statistical",
      "biological"
    ),
    detection_method = ifelse(
      detection_method == "statistical" &
        entryid  %in% biological_detected_haplotype_int,
      "statistical & biological",
      detection_method
    ),
    detection_method = ifelse(
      detection_method == "statistical" &
        entryid  %in% biological_detected_haplotype_slope,
      "statistical & biological",
      detection_method
    ),
    phenotype = ifelse(
      entryid %in% slp[which(slp$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype |
        entryid %in% biological_detected_haplotype_slope,
      "photoperiod sensitivity",
      "flowering time per se"
    ),
    phenotype = ifelse(
      phenotype == "photoperiod sensitivity" &
        entryid  %in% biological_detected_haplotype_int,
      "photoperiod sensitivity & flowering time per se",
      phenotype
    ),
    phenotype = ifelse(
      phenotype == "photoperiod sensitivity" &
        entryid  %in% int[which(int$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype,
      "photoperiod sensitivity & flowering time per se",
      phenotype
    ),
    phenotype = ifelse(
      phenotype == "flowering time per se" &
        entryid  %in% biological_detected_haplotype_slope,
      "photoperiod sensitivity & flowering time per se",
      phenotype
    ),
    phenotype = ifelse(
      phenotype == "flowering time per se" &
        entryid  %in% slp[which(slp$BH < 0.05), ]$haplotype,
      "photoperiod sensitivity & flowering time per se",
      phenotype
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(number_of_candidate_genes = number_of_candidate)


write.csv(
  result_table,
  file.path(genetic_data_save_path, paste0(date_today, "lines_detected_with_effect_PS_floperse.csv")),
  row.names = TRUE
)
```
